title: Lusin's theorem for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ: closed subsets of Borel sets, finite-dimensional targets
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let F be a finite-dimensional real normed space with its Borel σ-algebra, let u : ℝⁿ → F be Borel measurable (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), let S ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set and let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a closed set C ⊆ S with Lⁿ(S ∖ C) < ε such that the restriction u|C is continuous.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] (u : Rn n → F) (S : Set (Rn n)), Measurable u → MeasurableSet S → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ C ⊆ S, IsClosed C ∧ volume (S \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn u C
